requirements.title: INDEX argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING shall be character; SUBSTRING shall be character with the same kind type parameter as STRING; BACK shall be logical; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.INDEX-string-character: Positive plan calls INDEX with nonblank character STRING; a noncharacter mutation is source-control only with no diagnostic facet.
pending.INDEX-substring-character-same-kind: Positive plan calls INDEX with same-kind character STRING and SUBSTRING; a kind mismatch mutation is source-control only with no diagnostic facet.
pending.INDEX-back-logical: Positive plan uses BACK=.TRUE. and BACK=.FALSE. in otherwise identical calls so direction is load-bearing; wrong-type BACK mutation is source-control only.
pending.INDEX-kind-scalar-integer-constant: Positive plan supplies KIND=KIND(0) and asserts the result kind equals KIND(0); a nonconstant KIND mutation is source-control only.

pending.INDEX-kind-absent-default-kind: Assign KIND(INDEX('AB','B')) to a sentinel initialized to -777 and assert KIND(0).

requirements.title: INDEX returns first or last matching substring position according to BACK
requirements.definition: For a matching SUBSTRING, including a zero-length SUBSTRING, the result is the smallest matching position with absent or false BACK and the greatest matching position with true BACK.

pending.INDEX-forward-smallest-position: Use STRING='ABABA' and SUBSTRING='BA'; with BACK absent and BACK=.FALSE., assert exact result 2 from a sentinel initialized to -777; mutate by reversing BACK expectation.
pending.INDEX-backward-greatest-position: Use STRING='ABABA' and SUBSTRING='BA' with BACK=.TRUE., assert exact result 4 from a sentinel initialized to -777, paired with the forward result 2.
pending.INDEX-empty-substring-forward-one: Use non-empty STRING='ABCD' with SUBSTRING='' and result sentinel initialized to -777; evaluate INDEX(STRING,SUBSTRING) and INDEX(STRING,SUBSTRING,BACK=.FALSE.) and assert exact 1 for both. Companion uses zero-length STRING='' with SUBSTRING='' and asserts 1 for absent and false BACK too.
pending.INDEX-empty-substring-backward-len-plus-: Use non-empty STRING='ABCD' with SUBSTRING='' and BACK=.TRUE., initialize the result sentinel to -777, and assert exact LEN(STRING)+1, namely 5. Companion uses zero-length STRING='' with SUBSTRING='' and BACK=.TRUE. and asserts 1, separating LEN+1 from fixed 1.
